verdict.rationale: RingCentral sells business SMS and SMS APIs, so guided US A2P 10DLC brand/campaign registration with approval-status tracking is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions 10DLC, brand or campaign registration, or approval status. The only related item is a generic reference to 'compliance tools' in the Business SMS Booster add-on, which is an adjacent feature and does not evidence this capability.
